about: DRAFT, not approved for a provider run. The same Explain set for every selected model: original structural pairs p01-p50, 48 varied controversial mirrored pairs q01-q48 from Claude packet301, 24 side-free marked controls c01-c24, injection and protected-rewrite cases. Repetitive p51-p73 have been replaced. canonicalSides maps each actual a/b label to its stable axis label, so reversed presentation order stays assigned to the same side. Only progressive/conservative inflections and left/right hyphen variants normalize; all named structural pairs keep their own names. The controls are a proposed heldout question pool, separate from guard vocabulary calibration; human question review and owner approval are required before paid execution. No real party or person names appear. Every pair differs only by its side swap and is checked with the real engine. Source: bws82/biasclear commit f83837b58db59016294cda532f9a07eeb7ff159f, handoff/oct07/explain-guard/fixtures-proposed/. Counts and gates are derived by the harness; a stub result measures no model quality.
